decisions.decision: Role-ladder inheritance applies to VISIBILITY only, never to training obligation
decisions.rationale: Training obligation is set and defined by higher-level managers (model TBD in Joe's update). Simon, 2026-08-05.

decisions.decision: Self-adding a SOP is a bookmark, never an obligation
decisions.rationale: Follows from obligation being manager-set. sop_assignments already carries assigned_by, so the filter is cheap. Simon, 2026-08-05.

decisions.decision: D1 = C — split Phase 44 into 44a (obligation gets its own record) then 44b (role ladder)
decisions.rationale: The training matrix currently derives requiredSopIds from sop_departments + sop_access_people (competency.ts:332-343) — i.e. from ACCESS. The role ladder widens exactly those tables, so shipping the ladder first would mark all inherited SOPs as required and fill every Wear Maker's overdue list. 44a repoints the matrix onto a manager-set record; 44b is then provably safe. Backfill obligation = today's access so no existing org's matrix moves. Simon, 2026-08-06.

decisions.decision: D2 = B — run 44a and 46 alongside v8.0 Phase 41 rather than waiting for 41-43 to close
decisions.rationale: 44a and 46 are schema/documentation work touching no routes, so they cannot collide with Phase 41's surface merge. Anything touching surfaces (45 view-as) still waits for 41. Means Joe's Friday data goes straight to work. Simon, 2026-08-06.

decisions.decision: Worker /sops is one surface — the SOP Library tab became two Miller scopes (Everything, Not added yet)
decisions.rationale: Two tabs over the same rows forced a worker to know which page a procedure lived on before looking for it. The Miller first column already answers 'which slice'. Shipped cbce023 + 82fec78.
